entries.decision: Treat AI outputs as proposal material under a human-owned admission path: design specification -> AI draft -> human review -> validation -> repository / SSOT.
entries.reason: Prevent content velocity from outrunning canon coherence, provenance, state consistency, and milestone evidence.

entries.decision: Keep M0 / First Wake as the blocking representative slice before broad region, quest, enemy, item, ability, or final-asset scale-out.
entries.reason: Require player comprehension, persistence/restart stability, repeatable production pipelines, and representative visual/audio acceptance before expansion.
